## Request type

Governance / proposal / challenge / response / verification / promotion / result / archive

## File-based record

- Topic ID or governance scope:
- Author role/session and input commit:
- Changed artifacts:
- Evidence and adjudication paths:
- Dossier digest (if applicable):
- Experimental results versus forecasts:
- Validation commands and outcomes:
- Unresolved blockers:

## Independent review

- [ ] Role isolation and provenance recorded.
- [ ] Critical sources checked in versioned files.
- [ ] Objections adjudicated; unsupported objections do not block.
- [ ] Correctness, feasibility and meaningful-effect gates checked.
- [ ] Registered independent verifier will confirm the final head SHA.

Scientific arguments belong in files. Approval review body: `CONFIRM <full-head-sha>`.
